analogy.rationale: FASN inhibition blocks de novo lipogenesis, so drugs perturbing lipid/sterol synthesis (HMGCR, CPT1, lipase) should share downstream lipid-metabolic and ER stress programs; COX inhibition is included only because PTGS1 is an annotated target of some drugs in this class, and PPAR agonists because they modulate lipid handling.
